native.build: python tools/nbuild.py bridge --components far_copy decimal coordinate_scale

purpose: Borrowed ordered byte copy for AdLib event/voice state; owns no persistent state. It is intentionally neither memcpy nor memmove.

inputs: Two accessible initialized 65536-byte RAM windows, possibly overlapping with different base addresses
Independent uint16 source/destination cursors, uint16 count, backwards boolean
outputs: Destination bytes after exactly count ordered read-then-write steps; zero count does nothing
Bridge publishes CX=0 and preserves every other register/flag
effects: One source-byte read immediately followed by one destination-byte write per iteration
Both cursors independently wrap modulo 65536; no allocation, devices or callbacks
preconditions: Storage is ordinary RAM, without concurrent mutation, instruction-byte/VGA/device aliases or overlap with the live L0 stack (save, return and argument areas)
The two native pointers designate the actual shared storage if windows overlap, never independent snapshots
interface.projection: Bridge samples all low-word arguments before copying; source/destination segment arithmetic stays in bridge, direction becomes a boolean, high count word is never read.

callers.bounds: 20-byte records; normal i<9, distinct arrays. Copies only first 12 bytes.
callers.direction: Incoming DF; neither helper nor C caller establishes CLD. Do not assume forward for the component.
callers.observations: Saved state bytes, preserved DS/SI/DI/BP/ES; CX is conservatively live in the model.

callers.bounds: 12-byte event payload, voice selector 0..15; event pointer is external and can wrap/alias under malformed states.
callers.observations: Scanned instrument bytes; caller advances p by 11 after the call. No non-overlap theorem is assumed.

callers.bounds: Record stride 20. Normal positive n gives disjoint individual 12-byte copies; descending i preserves compaction order across calls. Zero n aliases exactly; malformed index/n states are not silently normalized.
callers.direction: Incoming DF, retained; descending record order is independent of byte direction.
callers.observations: CX=0 is a known live output; voice contents and preserved registers retained.

callers.bounds: Whole 20-byte records, normally i<MusicVoiceCount<=9 and arrays disjoint; no public malformed-state bound inferred.
callers.observations: Voice bytes feed instrument/frequency/volume calls; CX conservatively live, preserved registers retained.

callees.classification: Leaf; ordinary C array operations only.

indirect.classification: No indirect transfer inside the unit. Public entry permits callers outside the model only within this explicit RAM/stack contract.

read: Low count, source/destination far arguments on caller stack; high count ignored
Source ring byte at the current cursor; earlier destination writes are visible through aliases
write: Destination ring byte at each ordered cursor
Bridge CX only; L0 transient save frame excluded by precondition
owners: Borrowed SOUND AdlibVoiceStates/SavedAdlibVoiceStates/ScannedAdlibVoiceStates and external event storage; audio owns all of them
memory.aliases: Retain exact alias, forward/backward partial overlap, unequal-base physical alias and offset wrap; no restrict qualifiers or snapshot copying.

assumptions: Known call graph is not unrestricted completeness; unknown entries must satisfy the explicit boundary
Normal record/count facts describe callers; general API does not depend on their bounds
No interrupts/concurrent writers interleave the byte sequence

eliminated.detail: cdecl, segment values and USES save frame in ordinary native code
eliminated.evidence: L0 PROC samples far arguments, REP MOVSB, restores DS/ES/SI/DI/BP; bridge performs argument/address projection and preserves shell. C routine suites compare these observations.
L0 ARG arg_0008 is never loaded; L1 arg16(r,0) only. All five original C sites pass high=0; C copy cases also pass FEED and compare unchanged semantics.

retained.detail: Incoming direction, ordered overlap, independent offset wrap
retained.reason: REP MOVSB performs a read then a write in incoming DF order, without CLD or pointer normalization; caller contracts do not justify deleting these.

retained.detail: CX=0, flags and other registers unchanged
retained.reason: Caller model identifies live CX at several sites; REP MOVSB does not alter flags and USES restores saved registers. Bridge keeps the complete shell.

retained.detail: Low count zero means zero iterations
retained.reason: REP MOVSB semantics differ from several other game loops whose zero count runs 65536 times.

uncertainty: General full-ring overlap/copy-count equivalence remains C: arbitrary-overlap count<=20 timed out at 90 seconds in 64 bytes and at 120 seconds with full windows; even full-window count<=1 timed out at 45 seconds. No A claim from hand-written memory models or an unchecked induction.
Incoming DF may be one for public/malformed states; no whole-program DF-clear invariant has been proved.
No proof for VGA, concurrent mutation or live-stack aliasing; those remain outside the contract.
